name: Palladian Pharmaceutical Division Memo on Tier 2 Market Penetration
author: Palladian Pharmaceutical Division, Market Strategy Group
description:
STRATEGY MEMO — TIER 2 PHARMACEUTICAL MARKET PENETRATION DISTRIBUTION: Market Strategy Group, Senior Leadership

Executive Summary: Our Tier 2 market share for mood stabilizers and cognitive enhancers has grown from 12% to 31% in eighteen months. This memo outlines the strategy for reaching our target of 50% by Q4 2200.

The Tier 2 pharmaceutical market differs from our traditional Tier 3-5 customer base in three critical ways. First, Tier 2 consumers have less disposable income, which means pricing must be aggressive — we are currently operating at 15% margin in Tier 2 versus 62% margin in Tier 4-5. Second, Tier 2 consumers are more likely to obtain prescriptions through employer-mandated health screenings than through voluntary medical consultation, which means our referral partnerships with Tier 2 employers are the primary acquisition channel. Third, Tier 2 consumers have fewer alternative providers, which means once they begin a Palladian prescription, switching costs are high.

The employer partnership model is performing well. We have agreements with 340 Tier 2 employers who include Palladian cognitive enhancement screenings as part of their standard onboarding process. Of employees screened, 67% receive a recommendation for at least one Palladian product. This is not because 67% of Tier 2 workers need pharmaceutical cognitive enhancement. It is because our screening criteria are calibrated to identify enhancement opportunities rather than deficiencies.

Action items for Q1 2200: 1. Expand employer partnerships to 500 Tier 2 companies 2. Introduce 'starter pack' pricing: first three months at 50% discount, full price thereafter 3. Develop dependency management protocols that extend average prescription duration from 14 months to 24 months

Note on Item 3: Legal has requested we use the phrase 'treatment continuity optimization' in all internal communications rather than 'dependency management.' I have updated the terminology in this memo but want the strategy group to understand what we are actually discussing.
story_hooks: Employer-mandated screenings as a drug distribution channel
